# LearningPackageDraft 1.0.0

Purpose: represent an assembled but unpublished educational draft while
preserving instructional intent, ordered semantic blocks, source relationships,
agent provenance, quality state and authoring/governance lifecycle.

Canonical identifier: `urn:neuralverse:xfi:contract:learning-package-draft:1.0.0`
Semantic owner: Agent & Content Platform assembly and governance boundary.
Implemented consumers: neutral validation and preservation tooling only.
Future consumers: BIP persistence/versioning boundary after separate adoption
approval.

The schema preserves package identity, instructional statements, expected
depth, block identity and order, nested block payloads, source manifests,
citations, structured contribution provenance, ordered assembly stages,
laboratory and assessment versioned semantic references, coverage, unresolved
findings, validation, revisions and readiness recommendations. Storage
locations, HTML, CSS, frontend view models, database rows, release identities
and publication execution state are excluded.

The neutral shared metadata envelope is required. Explicit null, missing
optional values, Unicode, identifiers, timestamps and semantic array order are
preserved by the example runner. Projections remain non-authoritative.

The existing ACP representation uses flattened camelCase fields rather than
the prose section labels; this is recorded as an existing representation
divergence in the source matrix.
